name: Mara Sockdraw
acting: Uneven eyes up and clenched mouth.
personality: Refuses to buy another sock when this one is still in sight.
note: The laundry report listed one missing item and a strong suspicion of the ventilation system.
call: Stay on your side of the vent.

name: Gus Tubespoon
acting: Eager downcast gaze and one-tooth smile.
personality: Enjoys dinner best when it keeps its shape.
note: The meal held its spiral throughout our interview. Its flavor showed less commitment.
voice: Dry, with a slight upward inflection.

name: Iris Moonwindow
acting: Sidelong gaze and a barely parted smile.
personality: Carries her favorite view from room to room.
note: She says it is the same moon from every corridor. I tried to disagree and found her already there.

name: Tess Frostturn
props: ribbed heat dial with frost glyph
acting: Direct stern gaze and pursed lips.
personality: Treats a degree of difference as a genuine disagreement.
note: The station is comfortable at nineteen. Tess is comfortable when it agrees with her about nineteen.

name: Len Strapnap
personality: Fastens the pillow before he trusts the bed.
note: He claimed to have slept standing up. The pillow was the only thing prepared to confirm it.

name: Sid Borrowair
personality: Returns favors once the pressure has dropped.
note: The cylinder came back half full. Sid called this a partial return on air.
call: Can I borrow a little more?
